title: About Me
subtitle: Full stack developer, former laboratory technician
bio_intro: Eighteen years in medical analysis and food safety laboratories, several of them as a quality officer, before a complete career change into software. That path is not a detour: it taught me procedure, traceability and how to read a trade from the inside — exactly what you want from someone designing tools for other people.
bio_today: I currently work across several layers of an industrial ERP: Angular front end, Java/Spring back end and a Frappe ERP. Alongside that, I design and operate wikiwa.com, a TV series recommendation platform running in production, as a self-employed developer.
bio_location: Based in Feurs, in the Loire (42), France. I work remotely or hybrid.
bio_rqth: My profile includes an {{rqth}}, which simply means I need a hybrid work organization (partial remote or sedentary position), with no impact on my skills or commitment. I am autonomous, rigorous, and comfortable working both in a team and independently.
bio_goals: I look for projects where software serves a real trade: internal tools, business applications, platforms meant to be operated over time. The code that interests me is the code you can reread six months later without dreading it.
invite_contact: Let's discuss your needs, ideas, or projects to develop.
